text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
With this away trip course,
a day trip is possible, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To think that once surrounded,
I wouldn't even be able to dismount...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looks like we'll have to rework the expedition itinerary from scratch...
